scope: Selection of applicable mechanisms only; no math, OpenModelica compilation or numeric authorization. The four Hines originals have separate SHA/PySD evidence; MTO_S2_PATTERN is a tested IGC assembly, not a Hines original or standalone molecular class.

molecules.title: Capacity Utilization
molecules.purpose: Output rate governed by a desired production rate and an independent nominal capacity; its native curve is not a hard cap
requires: planned production independent of incoming orders
excludes: automatically restricting output to accepted customer orders
molecules.maturity: original SHA/PySD verified; OM equations tested in S1; wrapper not yet independent

molecules.title: Finished inventory and shipping backlog
molecules.purpose: Finished-goods inventory and accepted-but-not-shipped orders with shipping flow, production or replenishment supplied externally
requires: finished inventory distinct from unprepared jobs
excludes: equating backlog with work not yet prepared
molecules.maturity: original SHA/PySD verified; OM equations tested in S1; wrapper not yet independent

molecules.title: Material delay in transit
molecules.purpose: Stock of physical material in transit causing the output material flow to lag input material flow
requires: the same physical material flows through a delayed transit stage
excludes: administrative wait without physical material flow
automatically interpreting delayed customer order as material
molecules.maturity: original SHA/PySD verified; native OM molecule not yet tested

molecules.title: Accepted order queue, preparation and dispatch
molecules.origin: IGC S2 implemented with SystemDynamics + MSL
molecules.purpose: Accepted customer jobs accumulate before preparation; after processing, completed jobs wait in a second stage until dispatch; work is only prepared after order
requires: production starts only after an accepted order
excludes: independent production in advance to finished inventory
inference of capacities from registered sales
molecules.maturity: full synthetic S2 pattern compiled and parity tested, not a standalone molecular wrapper
